title: Combine a list of circuits
statement: Given a Boolean $b$ and a list of Boolean tree circuits, combine the list using the gate selected by $b$, with fuel equal to the length of the list. The selected gate is AND when $b$ is true and OR when $b$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a list of Boolean tree circuits on $n$ variables
